hints.content:
We can turn the rule into numbers and math symbols:

Rule: $\greenD{\text{Add }5}$ to $ \blueD x$ to get $\goldD y$.

$\blueD x \greenD{+5} = \goldD y$

Now we can use the rule to  complete the  table: 

$x$ | |$y$ 
:-: | :-: 
$\blueD2$ |  $\blueD2 \greenD{+5} =  \goldD7$ | $\goldD7$
$\blueD3$ |  $\blueD3 \greenD{+5} =  \goldD8$  | $\goldD8$
$\blueD4$ | $\blueD4 \greenD{+5}\ =  \goldD{9}$ |$\goldD{9}$

Each pair of $x$ and $y$ values in the table represents an ordered pair and a point on the graph. 

The ordered pairs are:  $(2, 7), (3, 8),$ and $(4, 9)$.

Now let's graph each point.

Each $x$ value represents a number on the horizontal axis.

Each $y$ value represents a number on the vertical axis.

To graph the point $(\blueD2,\goldD7)$, go right on the $x$-axis $\blueD2$ spaces and up on the $y$-axis $\goldD7$ spaces.


[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate grid is labeled 0 through 10 on the x-axis and the y-axis. A blue arrow moves right 2 units from the origin to the 2 on the x-axis. An orange arrow moves 7 units up from the 2 on the x-axis to align with the 7 on the y-axis. A point appears at the end of the orange arrow.
